name: Barbell
description: A long bar with weights attached at each end, used for weightlifting exercises.

name: Bench
description: A flat or adjustable surface used for various exercises, such as bench presses and dumbbell workouts.

name: Dumbbells
description: A short bar with weights on either end, used for strength training exercises.

name: Gym mat
description: A cushioned mat used for floor exercises, stretching, and yoga.

name: Incline bench
description: A bench that can be adjusted to different angles, allowing for a variety of exercises targeting different muscle groups.

name: Kettlebell
description: A cast-iron weight with a handle, used for ballistic exercises that combine cardiovascular, strength, and flexibility training.

name: Pull-up bar
description: A horizontal bar used for pull-ups and chin-ups, which are bodyweight exercises that target the upper body muscles.

name: Resistance band
description: A stretchy band used for strength training and rehabilitation exercises, providing resistance to help build muscle and improve flexibility.

name: SZ-Bar
description: A barbell with a zigzag shape, designed to reduce strain on the wrists during exercises like bicep curls and tricep extensions.

name: Swiss Ball
description: A large inflatable ball used for stability exercises, core strengthening, and improving balance.

name: Bodyweight
description: Using one's own body weight as resistance for exercises, such as push-ups, squats, and lunges.
